playbookOutputs: Completed Department of Employment and Labour Electrical Contractor Registration Pack (Annexure 3 & Annexure 5)
playbookCommonFailures: Registered Person (IE / MIE) wireman card has expired or is already linked full-time to another electrical contractor
Test instrument calibration certificates are older than 12 months

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Certificate (CIPC CoR 14.3)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the company CoR 14.3 registration certificate.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 registration certificate of the electrical contracting company.

informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID Copy (< 3 Months) of Registered Electrician & Directors + Proof of Business Address (< 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload certified SA ID copies (< 3 months) of the registered electrician (IE/MIE) and company directors, plus proof of physical business address (< 3 months).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Registered Person Wireman's Licence / Registration Card
informationToProvide.aiHint: Copy of DoEL registration certificate (Single Phase Tester, Installation Electrician, or Master Electrician).

informationToProvide.label: COIDA Letter of Good Standing
informationToProvide.aiHint: Current valid Letter of Good Standing from the Compensation Commissioner.

informationToProvide.label: Test Instrument Calibration Certificates
informationToProvide.aiHint: Calibration certificate for insulation resistance tester, earth loop impedance tester, etc. (< 12 months old).

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect electrician credentials and COIDA standing
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Wireman certificate, ID, calibration cert, and COIDA verified

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare Annexure 3 and Annexure 5 documentation
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Both annexures populated and ready for signature

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver completed pack and provincial labour office submission guide
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Delivered to client with submission guidance
